parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Whether to delete all, only effective when TagKey.N is empty. Allowed values: true, false, True, False. Default is false.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: Tag key group, up to 20 items

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-cnp untag-resources --resource-type ExperimentPlan --resource-id 189 --tag-key owner --all true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eflo-cnp UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All true --ResourceId.1 189 --TagKey.1 owner --ResourceType ExperimentPlan
